title: 金鯱賞の後に・動けない、動かない

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kawakami Princess completes the Kinko Sho.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Huff… Huff… Haaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She focused her entire body on emphasizing beauty in her running form…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But to me, she looked uncomfortable and constrained.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Huff… Wheeze… Huff… Huff…

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: (My body feels… sluggish. Was it always like this after a race?)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Way to go, Princess! That's our heroine!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Hey, give us another of your cool declarations!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Say you'll crush 'em all!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Um, but…

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: (Words like those attack others, so I shouldn't use them. They aren't what a queen should be saying.)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Ah… um…

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: (Huh? How am I supposed to behave after a race again?)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: (Address my fans? But I'm not the only star here. What would a queen do? Ummm…)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: (What's something Princess Fighter would do in this situation?)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: (What should I… do?)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Ha… haha… Ehehe…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kawakami Princess lets out a forced laugh, but her troubled expression makes it seem like she's about to cry…

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hold it!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: That laugh was super cringe! You're not acting like yourself at all!

text_block_list.name: Staff Member
text_block_list.text: What?! Hey, you can't come down here! Please return to your seat immediately!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: No! I'm not moving! Not until Kawakami listens to what I have to say!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Sweep…

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Why are you making that face?! You're being lame! You're acting super lame, Kawakami!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: What happened to all that talk about being true to yourself and keeping your dignity?! 'Cause this isn't…

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: This isn't like you at all! You're not Kawakami right now!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Give me the old Kawakami back! The Kawakami I care about!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Wh-why must you say these selfish things?! I am a princess, so I must conduct myself with dignity!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Wouldn't you hate it too?! If the winner of the race is someone you can't respect, then…

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Why should I care?! It doesn't make any difference to me!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Well… even it it doesn't bother you… Other people might not feel the same…
choice_data_list: Can I talk to you for a moment?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: …Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
choice_data_list: Behaving with dignity is an admirable thing.
Behaving with dignity is an admirable thing.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
choice_data_list: But I think being true to yourself is just as admirable.
But I think being true to yourself is just as admirable.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: So, you're saying both ways are right? Then… how?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: What am I… supposed to do?
choice_data_list: Think once more about what your ideal self looks like.
Think once more about what your ideal self looks like.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: …My ideal self?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Well, I…

text_block_list.name: Staff Member
text_block_list.text: Hey! Hurry up and clear out of here! We have another race today!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Shooed away by one of the staff members, we leave the track.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I'm entering the Victoria Mile, so make sure you enter, too. And you better have your act together by then.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I'll tell you one thing right now. The Kawakami I know would never sit back and take all this dissing without doing anything about it.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: The Victoria Mile…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: No doubt she feels conflicted.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She doesn't understand the difference between just being herself and being selfish, between being dignified and holding herself back.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's losing sight of how her ideal self—the princess she wishes to become—should act.

text_block_list.name: Monitor
text_block_list.text: Things are heating up at Chukyo Racecourse this month! It will soon be time for the electrifying spring contest—the Takamatsunomiya Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Monitor
text_block_list.text: With the Umamusume who calls herself first-rate entering the fray, who will become the queen of the sprint?!

text_block_list.name: Monitor
text_block_list.text: We'll also be holding a Princess Fighter event! Parents who bring along their children will receive free merch! ♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: …Ah.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our next stop is the Victoria Mile, where I'm sure Kawakami Princess will rediscover her ideal self.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As her trainer, I must guide her along the best path.
